While boxing kits are included as part of certain plans, they are introduced once a member reaches the required foundational readiness. The kit is provided at no additional cost at that stage, as it is meant to support skill development after the basics are in place.
Our sessions operate in a coached group-training format, where trainers supervise multiple members simultaneously, provide corrections, and guide progression throughout the session. This model is designed to ensure structured attention within a group environment rather than continuous one-to-one supervision. We regret if this approach did not align with your expectations or was not perceived adequately during your training period.
We encourage all members to communicate any concerns or expectations during their active training so that adjustments or additional guidance can be provided in real time.
Over the past 7+ years, we have trained beginners through to competitive boxers, including athletes who have earned medals at recognised competitions, and we remain committed to professional, structured coaching standards.
